text:
sam: FYI Olivia from Fintegrate just asked for a 2-week POC. They want private network + security answers and a rough cost + GPU sizing estimate before legal signs off.
alex: need quick profile: expected daily requests? avg prompt/response tokens? any latency SLOs or eval pass rate targets?
maria: we should also confirm dataset residency and whether logs can be disabled. Fintegrate is regulated.
olivia: hi team — thanks. goals: 1) integrate via VPC peering, 2) p95 latency < 400ms for up to 512 token responses, 3) quality: >=80% pass on our 200-case eval set. Traffic: expected ~10k requests/day, burst up to 20 rps during demos. Avg prompt ~60 tokens, avg completion ~140 tokens.
alex: ok math quick:
```
requests_per_day = 10_000
tokens_per_request = 60 + 140 = 200
tokens_per_day = requests_per_day * tokens_per_request  # 2,000,000
peak_burst_rps = 20
avg_tokens_per_request = 200
peak_tokens_per_sec = peak_burst_rps * avg_tokens_per_request = 4,000 tps
```
alex: with that profile, for a 13B-ish open model quantized we estimate:
- single H100-class GPU -> handles bursts up to ~25 rps with p95 <400ms (depends on batching)
- single A100/4090-class -> maybe borderline at sustained 15-20 rps p95 might exceed 400ms under worst-case
- recommended for POC: 1x H100-equivalent dedicated node to hit confidence targets
maria: alternative cheaper POC: 2x smaller GPUs in a shared pool + aggressive batching and KV caching. That would save cost but risks demo latency during burst.
devon: infra notes: for VPC peering we need customer's CIDR + approval for peering from their network team. We'll need to schedule a 1-hour network runbook call. Also need their KMS ARN if they want CMK for keys.
olivia: budget-wise Fintegrate has ~$6k set aside for POC. Is that feasible for the H100 option?
alex: rough cost estimate (all numbers rough):
- H100 node: ~$12/hr GPU + infra -> ~$15/hr total
- 14 days * 24 hrs * $15 = $5040
- supplementary infra (e.g., logging retention, egress) estimate: ~$500–$800
- total POC estimate: ~$5.5k–$6k (fits their budget if we keep things minimal)
maria: cheaper option numbers:
- 2x smaller GPUs in burst pool: ~$6/hr total -> 14d * 24 * 6 = ~$2016
- but add engineering time and possible demo risk. Recommend H100 if they care about latency guarantees.
sam: callout — security questionnaire: Olivia can you share which sections are blockers? We can prefill most: SOC2, KMS, data residency, support for Private deployment.
olivia: main blockers: data not to leave EU, audit trail for inference requests, KMS with customer-controlled keys, and vendor-side access policy. They also want offline deployment option for prod later.
sec-bot: SECURITY CHECKLIST: SOC2 Type II (yes), VPC/Private control plane (yes), KMS/HSM integration (partial — customer keys supported in Private), data residency (EU regions available), audit logs (available, retention configurable).
alex: action items:
- devon: schedule network runbook with Fintegrate (owner: devon)
- sam: confirm POC acceptance criteria doc with Olivia (owner: sam)
- maria: prepare quick eval harness + 200-case scoring script (owner: maria)
- alex: provision H100 transient node and scoped billing estimate in pricing deck (owner: alex)
sam: timeline proposal: week0 (setup + security review), week1 (integration + smoke tests), week2 (load tests + evals + final handoff). total 14 calendar days from kickoff.
olivia: that timeline works. Please confirm the final estimate and send me the questionnaire answers this week.
alex: will do. if budget tight we can start on 2x smaller nodes and swap to H100 mid-POC if needed. ping me if they need a formal quote.
maria: I'll drop the eval harness link in here after I finish (short script + scoring). Expect it by EOD.
devon: scheduling note: need their VPN/contact details to start peering — otherwise network can add 3 business days.
sam: perfect. once we have their CIDR and KMS ARN I'll open the request. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
olivia: thanks team — will send CIDR + questionnaire this afternoon. excited to get started :rocket:
